notes: sha256 is enforced for every downloaded profile (kind = download). Local entries ship with Windows or the OEM and stay where they are; their bytes vary between Windows builds, so the hash observed on the reference machine is recorded in sha256_reference and is informational only — it is never used to reject a local file.

No entry here is a per-unit calibration. OEM panel profiles are colour-space baselines, not measurements of the individual panel. A review profile improves average accuracy; it does not replace a colorimeter.
Only profiles that were present on the reference machine, or downloadable from a public URL verified on 2026-11-09, are listed. No URL or hash in this file is guessed.

The OEM also ships EDO4503_HDR.icc, an MHC2/HDR profile with a 700 cd/m2 luminance tag. It is consumed by the HDR pipeline and is NOT offered here: applied as an SDR display profile it would distort SDR colours, and Windows ignores SDR ICC while HDR is on. Left in place, untouched.

entries.license_note: Microsoft Windows standard profile. MiControl uses the copy already installed on this machine and does not redistribute it.
entries.description: The Windows reference sRGB profile. Correct baseline for SDR desktop content and the safe choice for any panel.

entries.license_note: Shipped by the OEM into the Windows colour directory. Its own description tag reads 'MSFT TEST: D65P3 base profile' — a colour-space baseline, not a measurement of this unit.
entries.description: Maps the panel to Display P3 primaries at D65 (white point 0.9505, 1.0000, 1.0891). Wider than sRGB: only correct when the panel really covers P3 and the content is colour-managed.
